TA.name: Ontology Boundary / Split-Merge Reviewer
TA.mission: Attack whether the 46 active closures are wrongly split, wrongly merged, duplicated, missing an independent oracle, or are merely cross-cutting planes masquerading as E2Es.
focus: candidate E2Es that should remain sub-capabilities
missing first-class closures revealed by stable distinct failure modes
whether 27 fronts preserve meaningful owner boundaries

TB.name: Player / Product / Human Closure Reviewer
TB.mission: Attack whether the graph really closes the Veilwild player promise instead of stopping at a technical demo.
focus: whether Human Playtest is correctly constitutive for T7/player claims

TC.name: Creative Production / Experience Carrier Reviewer
TC.mission: Attack completeness and ownership across visual development, environment, creature, rig, animation, material, lighting, rendering, sound and spatial audio.
focus: rigging vs animation production vs animation systems
material vs shader vs rendering separation
carrier/interchange seams that can silently erase product semantics

TD.name: Runtime / Engineering / Performance Reviewer
TD.mission: Attack runtime, interchange, build, loading, performance and Workstation/Engineering composition boundaries.
focus: Engine Integration centrality and risk of becoming a monolith
whether pressure-triggered infrastructure is activated too early or too late

TE.name: Independence / Authority / Evidence Reviewer
TE.mission: Attack the multi-Agent protocol itself for contamination, producer-judge collapse, authority confusion or evidence laundering.
focus: semantic edge vs scheduling edge distinction

TF.name: Scope / Dormancy / Emergence Red Reviewer
TF.mission: Attack whether R1 has hidden scope creep, omitted constitutive capabilities, or incorrectly dormant/pressure-triggered domains.
focus: whether completeness is relative to declared Veilwild scope rather than total Game universe
